---
title: "Sluggers"
---

```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(Lahman)
```

```{r}
Batting |>
  group_by(playerID) |>
  summarize(
    career_home_runs = sum(HR, na.rm = TRUE),
    first_year = min(yearID),
    last_year = max(yearID),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  slice_max(career_home_runs, n = 15, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  left_join(People |> select(playerID, nameFirst, nameLast), by = "playerID") |>
  transmute(
    Player = paste(nameFirst, nameLast),
    `Career home runs` = career_home_runs,
    `Seasons played` = paste(first_year, "to", last_year)
  ) |>
  knitr::kable()
```
